CHEMISTRY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHEMISTRY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrochemistry ● Redox reactions ● Electrochemical cell ● Standard electrode p? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrochemistry ● Redox reactions ● Electrochemical cell ● Standard electrode p.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrochemistry ● Redox reactions ● Electrochemical cell ● Standard electrode p.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrochemistry ● Redox reactions ● Electrochemical cell ● Standard electrode p.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrochemistry ● Redox reactions ● Electrochemical cell ● Standard electrode p.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

4. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electrochemistry ● Redox reactions ● Electrochemical cell ● Standard electrode p and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
